comparison: Original four RectangleBlocks with geometry feedback vs four hidden Attention+SwiGLU blocks and one global-conditioned readout; neither has downstream layers; only final output supervised

comparison_limit: Near parameter budget; complete design comparison, not isolated geometry-feedback ablation or equal FLOPs
initialization: Scratch seed0; same copied fresh input/norm/qkv/output/local initial tensors; incompatible FFNs/readouts freshly initialized; no checkpoint reads; common global CPU RNG preserved

budget: Prospective per-arm4h/200epoch caps; preparation is not launch authorization; compare actual epochs/steps/time and common steps separately

stop: Experiment/run STOP and SIGINT; no next arm automatically
